parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly of the cooling fan, made of ABS plastic for durability and lightweight performance.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or circulating air within a system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame or housing of the cooling fan, made of ABS plastic to provide structural support and mounting points.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, ensuring stability and proper alignment during operation.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary, serving as the fixed support structure for the rotating fan assembly.
